Post 1

📉 Materials crushed, uranium in freefall — the ASX 200 dropped 78.20pts or 0.89% to 8,741.20, a fresh 20-day low. A brutal week: -2.94% in five days. One sector alone explains most of the damage. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

⛏️ Materials -3.63% led the wreckage, IT -2.06% close behind. Financials were the sole bright spot at +1.08%, with insurers carrying the load. Everything else was either flat or red. #ASX #mining #banking

Post 3

🔻 Uranium got hammered. DYL fell 9.87% to AUD 1.415, PDN dropped 9.59% to AUD 10.28. Two of the index's biggest uranium names, both crushed on the same session. Sector confidence is cracking. #ASX #uranium

Post 4

🪙 Gold held firm at AUD 6,121.25/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7176. Silver at AUD 89.88/oz. Metals didn't save materials today — the selling was stock-specific, not commodity-driven. #gold #silver #ASX #ausbiz

Post 5

Financials bucked the trend Friday. Can insurers hold next week, or does broad selling drag them down too? Watch AUD/USD at 0.7176 — any USD strength pressures the index further. Where do you see support? #ASX #ausbiz #FX
